import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(data: np.ndarray) -> plt.Axes:
    arr = np.asarray(data)

    if not np.issubdtype(arr.dtype, np.number):
        raise TypeError("Input array must contain numeric values.")

    if np.issubdtype(arr.dtype, np.complexfloating):
        raise TypeError("Input array must contain real numeric values.")

    arr = np.ravel(arr)

    if np.isnan(arr).any():
        raise ValueError("Input array must not contain NaN values.")

    if (arr < 0).any():
        raise ValueError("Input array must not contain negative values.")

    sorted_data = np.sort(arr.astype(float, copy=False))
    n = sorted_data.size

    if n == 0:
        cumulative_probability = np.array([], dtype=float)
    else:
        total = sorted_data.sum()
        if total == 0:
            cumulative_probability = np.zeros(n, dtype=float)
        else:
            cumulative_probability = np.cumsum(sorted_data) / total

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    ax.plot(np.arange(n), cumulative_probability, marker="o", linestyle="-")
    ax.set_title("Cumulative Probability Plot")
    ax.set_xlabel("Index")
    ax.set_ylabel("Cumulative Probability")

    return ax
